scope: A visual field-guide explorer for five existing sourced reef relationships; eight animal-group explanations in profiles and supported comparisons; improved low-detail feather-duster worm and visible rock attachment; observation focus continuity.

learning.connections: Paired portraits link to either profile or comparison. The exact pair's existing source and directional explanation appear in comparison. Captive-observation and genus-level qualifications remain. Returning restores the originating control and preserves filters, bookmarks, field notes and discovery records.
learning.limits: Animal-group notes explain body plans, not definitive field identification. The relationship gallery is a small curated selection, not a complete food web. No new species or encounter counts were added in this revision.

visuals.featherDusterLow: 48 banded feather vanes retain the silhouette in smoother detail. The model has 2976 triangles and two draws; the existing high-detail crown remains unchanged. Tube albedo is lighter without adding emission.
visuals.attachment: Both filter feeders select exposed rock. Placement checks actual rock and floor triangles, avoids buried shoulders, seats the base 2 mm into the surface, and aligns to the rock face.

verification.focusedTests: Gallery/profile/comparison navigation, sourced animal groups, accessibility themes, i18n, deferred-focus ownership, geometry/texture disposal, supported material families and multi-seed exposed-rock attachment pass.
verification.browser: Seven desktop/phone guide checks and eighteen real-WebGL dive checks pass. All thirteen added-species observation flows, including varicose phyllidia, complete. No browser, shader or network errors.
verification.priorTimeouts: The material-family test now caches identical model requests without reducing its assertions and passes. The broad thirteen-species browser flow passes at low detail. The original high-detail SwiftShader run is not a hardware performance benchmark.
verification.deployment: Local source, desktop mirrors and portrait assets synchronized; no public deployment.
